format: JSON Lines; one task per line

top_level_fields.source: String containing executable Python code for the ARC-style transformation, including the task concepts and description in comments.
top_level_fields.examples: List of input-output grid pairs. Each pair is represented as [input_grid, output_grid], where each grid is a 2D integer array with values 0-9.
top_level_fields.seeds: List of generation support artifacts inherited from the task synthesis pipeline. The field usually contains four retrieved ARC-style seed example references (e.g., .py filenames) plus one generated task sketch containing concepts and description. It does not denote random seeds.
top_level_fields.task_id: Integer canonical experiment task ID (1-1614), verified through unique SHA-256 matching of exact source code and equality of examples and generation artifacts. IDs are not JSONL line numbers.
top_level_fields.alignment: Object with score, status and unscored_reason, described in alignment_fields. Original source/examples/seeds fields are preserved exactly.

alignment_fields.score: Finite cosine similarity float in [-1, 1], stored without decimal rounding, or null when no reverse caption was returned.
alignment_fields.status: One of scored or unscored. scored requires a finite score and null unscored_reason; unscored requires null score and the verified reason.
alignment_fields.unscored_reason: null for scored tasks; reverse_caption_max_output_tokens for six tasks whose two reverse-caption attempts each reached 16,384 output tokens without a caption.

fields.task_id: Same canonical integer ID as in data/data.jsonl.
fields.source_sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the exact source string encoded as UTF-8; excludes JSON escaping and enclosing JSON.
fields.alignment: Same object and field contract as the main task record.
fields.reverse_caption: Anonymous grid-only transformation caption used in scoring, or null for the six unscored tasks.

alignment_sidecar.order: Same record order as data/data.jsonl; use task_id for joins.

grid_shape_contract: Stored grids are nonempty rectangular 2D integer arrays. Dimensions are not uniformly bounded by 30x30: 798 tasks meet that bound for every stored input and output; 816 tasks contain at least one larger grid. See statistics.json for size counts and independently computed maxima.
alignment_filter: Keep records with alignment.status == scored and alignment.score >= threshold. A null score is unknown and is excluded from thresholded subsets.
